result.description:
Our valued client, IDEC Solutions are seeking to employ suitably qualified Welders to join their busy team of professionals working out of their Murarrie depot.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
May operate equipment, including but not limited to lathes, mills, drill press, press-breaks, shears, and cutting tables

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Welder/Fabricator – Multiple Permanent Opportunities

Perth, Western Australia | Full-Time | Sponsorship Available

MYAC Resources is seeking experienced Welder/Fabricators to join our growing network of leading employers across Perth, Western Australia.

We have multiple long-term opportunities available for skilled tradespeople who take pride in producing high-quality work and want to build a secure and rewarding career with established Australian businesses.

Whether you are already living in Australia or looking to relocate from overseas, employer sponsorship may be available for suitably qualified candidates.

About the Role

As a Welder/Fabricator, you will be involved in the fabrication, assembly and repair of metal components across a range of manufacturing, engineering and industrial projects.

Working in modern, well-equipped workshops, you will be part of a professional team committed to quality workmanship and high safety standards.

Your responsibilities may include:

Manufacturing components and welded assemblies from engineering drawings.
Completing precision fabrication and welding work in accordance with quality requirements.
Working with mechanical and engineering teams to manufacture high-quality products.
Identifying repair requirements and estimating repair times.
Operating fabrication machinery and workshop equipment.
Inspecting completed work to ensure it meets the required standards.
Maintaining a clean, organised and safe work area.
About You

To be successful, you will have:

Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade, including MEM30305, MEM31922, MEM30319 or MEM31925, or an equivalent recognised qualification.
A minimum of three to five years’ experience as a Welder/Fabricator or Boilermaker.
Proficiency in FCAW, GMAW and CAC-A (Air Carbon Arc Cutting).
The ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and fabrication plans.
The ability to complete welding qualification tests to AS/NZS 1554 SP requirements.
Experience operating fabrication machinery and workshop equipment.
Strong fabrication, measuring and welding skills.
High attention to detail and pride in producing quality workmanship.
The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Good communication and problem-solving skills.
A strong commitment to workplace safety and quality standards.
A reliable attitude and strong work ethic.
The ability to complete a pre-employment medical, drug and alcohol screening, and other required employment checks.
Highly Regarded
Forklift Licence (LF).
Current Australian C Class Driver’s Licence.
Dogging (DG), Basic Rigging (RB) or EWP High Risk Work Licence.
Previous experience within heavy fabrication, mining, manufacturing or industrial environments.
What’s on Offer
Permanent, full-time employment.
Multiple opportunities across Perth, Western Australia.
Competitive salary packages with overtime opportunities.
Long-term career stability with established Australian employers.
Modern workshop facilities and quality equipment.
Ongoing training and career development.
Supportive and safety-focused team environments.
Employer sponsorship opportunities for eligible candidates.
Support for suitably qualified overseas applicants planning to relocate to Australia.
Employer Sponsorship

MYAC Resources has extensive experience connecting skilled tradespeople with genuine, long-term employment opportunities across Australia.

Employer sponsorship may be available for suitably qualified candidates, subject to employer approval, skills assessment requirements and Australian migration eligibility.

Why Join MYAC Resources?

MYAC Resources specialises in connecting skilled tradespeople with leading employers across Australia’s manufacturing, engineering, mining and industrial sectors.

We don’t just recruit people—we help build long-term careers. From your initial application through to placement and ongoing support, our recruitment team is committed to helping you succeed.

Apply Now

If you are an experienced Welder/Fabricator looking for your next opportunity in Perth, we would like to hear from you.

Submit your application using the Apply Now button or email your current resume to recruitment@myacresources.com.au.

One of our recruitment specialists will contact shortlisted applicants to discuss available opportunities.

result.description: Sam Mills Pty Ltd   Company:  Sam Mills Pty Ltd   Position:  Mechanical Engineer    Employment Type:  Permanent, Full-time   Salary Range:  $90,000 - $100,000 per annum plus Superannuation   Location:  3/58 Gawler Road, Virginia South Australia 5120   ABN:  64607811914   Position Overview  - Reporting to the Director/Manager, the Mechanical Engineer plans, designs, installs, commissions and improves mechanical plant and equipment for Sam Mills Pty Ltd's milling and manufacturing operations. The role carries out preventive and corrective maintenance, investigates equipment faults and implements engineering improvements, with a strong focus on workplace health and safety, food-safety requirements, plant reliability and production efficiency. The Mechanical Engineer plays a key role in supporting efficient milling and packing operations, minimising downtime, and contributing to overall team performance and operational excellence.   Benefits   Competitive salary package.  An opportunity to work with a highly recognizable brand and make a meaningful impact on the community.  Opportunity to work in a supportive and inclusive team environment.  Work-life balance with a structured schedule.  Employee discounts on products.    Task & responsibilities   KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES   The main responsibilities will encompass, but are not limited to:   Mechanical Design & Documentation    Design and review machinery, components and plant layouts using CAD, engineering calculations and applicable standards.  Prepare drawings, specifications, bills of materials and technical reports    Flour-Milling Plant Engineering & Reliability    Support roller mills, plansifters, purifiers, grain-cleaning equipment, conveyors, pneumatic systems, dust extraction, compressors, silos and packing machinery.  Inspect equipment condition, analyse failures and implement design, operating or maintenance changes to improve reliability, product flow and asset life.    Installation & Commissioning    Plan and supervise installation, alignment, testing and commissioning of machinery, conveyors, pumps and related systems.  Support maintenance teams and verify work against design, quality and safety requirements.    Engineering Projects & Procurement    Define scope, schedules, budgets and resources for equipment upgrades and capital works.  Evaluate quotations and coordinate suppliers, fabricators and contractors.    Safety, Compliance & Risk Management    Conduct risk assessments and ensure guarding and safe design comply with WHS and relevant Australian Standards.  Support site quality, food-safety and environmental requirements.    Continuous Improvement & Engineering Records    Use root-cause analysis and operating data to improve efficiency, throughput and maintainability.  Maintain drawings, manuals, asset data and change-control records, and provide technical training as required.    Essential Skills and Abilities    Strong knowledge of mechanical design, materials, manufacturing methods, rotating equipment, conveyors, hydraulics and pneumatics.  Proficiency in CAD and preparation and interpretation of engineering drawings, calculations and specifications.  Demonstrated mechanical fault-finding, root-cause analysis, reliability and maintenance-planning skills.  Ability to deliver engineering projects and coordinate suppliers and contractors.  Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical personnel.   Sound knowledge of WHS, safe design, risk management, Australian Standards and environmental requirements       Role Requirements    Availability to work full-time hours in accordance with business needs.  Some local travel may be required as per the business requirements.  This position is open to Australian citizens, permanent residents, and holders of valid work visas.   Occasional overtime or work outside normal hours during shutdowns, breakdowns or commissioning by mutual agreement.  The role combines office work with inspections in operational plant areas, including noise, dust, stairs and platforms.  Required PPE includes steel-cap boots, high-visibility clothing, and eye and hearing protection.  Site hygiene, food-safety, lockout/tagout, WHS and environmental procedures must be followed.        How to Apply:  Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated CV and a cover letter outlining their suitability for the role. Applications must be complete to be considered. Only shortlisted applicants will be notified.      Equal Opportunity Employer:  Sam Mills is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.   Qualification & experience   Qualifications and Experience    Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Mechanical Engineering, or recognised equivalent.  Minimum 1 Year of experience in manufacturing, milling or an industrial plant environment.  Proficiency with CAD and standard engineering, project and maintenance documentation systems.  Full, unrestricted work rights in Australia.  Working knowledge of WHS and environmental standards      About Company     Sam Mills Pty Ltd is a leading flour milling company based in Virginia, South Australia. We specialise in producing high-quality wheat and gram flour, and specialty flour products tailored to customer needs. Our commitment to quality and consistency is supported by state-of-the-art milling processes and a wide distribution network serving retail, wholesale and food service customers across Australia and overseas.        Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $90000-100000   Job Publish:  20-07-2026   Job Expire:  19-08-2026  Apply on:  Mechanical Engineer Job here!
